I'm working on 3 products now:

1. FormBeep(https://formbeep.com) at $38 MRR now - A form to Whatsapp tool. Stack is mainly CF workers with Clerk Auth.

2. SlashLink(https://slashlink.app) $0 - A simple pay as you go amazon link localizer. Great for affiliate folks and a cheaper alternative to Genius. Stack is same, CF workers with SQLite(D1)

3. StackStats(https://stackstats.app) $791 - A better advanced analytics app for Substack writers, fully local. I have been writing on Substack for a while now and their analytics suck!
